# devices-mcp
> Home security and IoT orchestration MCP server. Unified dashboard for Tapo cameras, Ring doorbells, Nest Protect, Philips Hue lighting, Netatmo weather, Shelly devices, and more.

## Docs
- [Readme](README.md): Home Security MCP Platform — dual-architecture with individual device MCP servers + unified surveillance dashboard.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): v1.21.1 — webapp bug fixes (lighting, logs, PC health).
- [Assessment](docs/assessment.md): Comprehensive repository assessment with tool inventory and architecture analysis.
- [Web-SOTA](web-sota/README.md): Vite + React SPA dashboard on ports 10716/10717 (created if needed).
- [Justfile](justfile): Task runner — `just lint`, `just fix`, `just dev`, `just typecheck`, `just build`.

## API
- [Health](web-sota/backend/routes/system.py): `GET /api/health`, `GET /api/system/connection-health`
- [Lighting](web-sota/backend/routes/lighting.py): `GET /api/lighting/status`, `GET /api/lighting/scenes`, `GET /api/lighting/hue/status`
- [Logs](web-sota/backend/routes/logs.py): `GET /api/logs`, `GET /api/logs/stats`, `POST /api/logs/analyze`
- [Cameras](web-sota/backend/routes/cameras.py): Camera management endpoints
- [Energy](web-sota/backend/routes/energy.py): Smart plug power monitoring
- [Weather](web-sota/backend/routes/weather.py): Netatmo weather station data
- [Ring](web-sota/backend/routes/ring.py): Ring doorbell and alarm
- [Nest](web-sota/backend/routes/nest.py): Nest Protect smoke/CO alarms

## Tools
- **Portmanteau**: `camera_management`, `lighting_management`, `energy_management`, `weather_management`, `security_management`, `ring_management`, `ptz_management`, `messages_management`, `automation_management`
- **Atomic**: `list_cameras`, `move_ptz`, `capture_image`, `get_hue_lights`, `control_hue_light`, `get_homeaware_status`, and 30+ more

## Config
- [Pyproject](pyproject.toml): Python project dependencies and metadata
- [Frontend](web-sota/frontend/package.json): Vite + React 18 + shadcn/ui

## Ports
- 10715: USB Camera helper (Windows, optional)
- 10716: Frontend Vite dev
- 10717: Backend FastAPI + FastMCP
